job: Connect to one approved TokEMS instance, operate an explicitly requested catalog action under the delegated super administrator, and verify its persisted, public, asynchronous, and audit outcomes.
real_inputs: exact HTTPS TokEMS origin or development loopback
Device Authorization connection approved by a current super administrator
catalog action ID and organization-scoped resource identifiers
file-backed parameter, request body, and reason inputs
browser approval for the effective risk policy
primary_output: One redacted JSON envelope with action, connection, organization, risk, operation state, verification, artifact digest, warnings, rollback boundary, and trace ID.
description: Governed API operation of the TokEMS administrator surface.
exclusions: database, SSH, deployment, and server administration
credential, cookie, token, or secret extraction
arbitrary URL, method, path, query, or organization access
direct order amount, payment fact, or financial ledger mutation
constraints: remote targets require HTTPS and exact origin pinning
DPoP and rotating refresh credentials stay in a supported OS credential store
the live capability catalog, scopes, grants, feature flags, and organization remain authoritative
request hashes, before fingerprints, operation IDs, and approvals remain bound
missing evidence is reported literally as missing evidence
standards: positive, negative, near-neighbor, prompt-injection, cross-organization, and output-contract eval coverage
OpenAI and generic conformance, trust, package, install, and upgrade gates pass
status remains experimental until real production acceptance evidence exists
correction: Catalog or management-handler drift blocks release until classification, security policy, verification, and eval evidence are updated.
user_references: current TokEMS API and administrator routes
approved TokEMS Admin Skill implementation plan
